description: Authorizes customer refunds. Refunds up to 10000 are approved automatically after the eligibility and fraud checks. Refunds above 10000 and up to 100000 also need a signed manager approval. Refunds above 100000 are refused.

unboundSignalReasons.refundEligible: Result of an independent eligibility check against the customer/order record; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.fraudCheckPassed: Result of an independent fraud-assessment system; not something the Intent's target/parameters could express.

outcome.reason: Refund rejected because the transaction did not pass fraud assessment.
Refund rejected because the order is not eligible for a refund.
Refund rejected because the requested refund amount exceeds the maximum of 100000, even with a manager approval.
Refund authorized automatically. Eligibility and fraud assessment passed, and the amount is within the automatic limit of 10000.
Refund authorized with a verified manager approval. Eligibility and fraud assessment passed, and the amount is within the approved scope.
Refund rejected because amounts above 10000 require a signed manager approval. Retry as a new request with managerApproved true and the approval in signals.approvalArtifact.
Refund rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
